Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No. 391/2016 dated 21.05.2016 registered under Section 498A/406 IPC at PS Nihal Vihar and consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.
The quashing is based on a settlement dated 17.12.2022 before the Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, New Delhi, wherein the respondent No.2 was to be paid a total sum of Rs. 27.5 lakhs.
A sum of Rs. 20 lakhs has already been paid the respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs. 7.5 lakhs is being paid today in Court vide DD No. 000088 dated 08.05.2023 drawn

sentences.text: The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Dipesh Choudhary, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by SI Parvesh, PS Nihal Vihar.
The parties state that they have arrived at a settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.
For the said reasons, the FIR No. 391/2016 dated 21.05.2016 registered under Section 498A/406 IPC at PS Nihal Vihar and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
The petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
JASMEET SINGH, J MAY 19, 2023 / (MS)
